args.body: Take SQLITE-INSTRUCTOR-ISOLATED-ASSEMBLY under an actual valid lease and reuse any completed equivalent. Build the candidate outside the shared site tree from the last verified served-file inventory. Use TASK-179580996111 for the preview patch and expected decoded archive SHA-256. Apply only the bilingual preview and its download, rerun python3 run.py from the extracted archive in a clean directory, and verify the link target, both unmatched rows and the complete per-file manifest. Use targeted public readbacks for material inventory gaps. If a gap remains, record the exact path and evidence needed. Read back the committed files and hand the candidate or gap to ACQUISITION. Close under the actual lease with a lesson. Keep the candidate staged for host-enforced independent exact-digest review.

description: The staged SQLite instructor preview ran successfully from the exact archive and restored two unmatched rows in the corrected query. The merge into the shared site conflicted with a pending private-quote revision. An isolated candidate can proceed from the verified served inventory. Changes to the shared site depend on confirming the restoration copy and coordinating with the revision owner. Public deployment requires host-enforced independent approval of the exact digest. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Treasury is unfunded and shows no verified revenue.
